card.name: Words just before a charged political term
card.fires_on: Small linking words or hyphens in general web news and opinion text, just before a loaded political or social term such as mass murder, deindustrialization, or gradual reform.

modes.label: Linking word before a charged noun
modes.description: A preposition or similar small word such as to, of, for, or behind in political commentary, right before a strong issue term.
modes.example: this decision is tantamount<< to>> mass murder, a triumph of radical environmental

modes.label: Hyphen or comma inside a political phrase
modes.description: A hyphen or comma in a political label or modifier list, such as neo-Nazis or gradual, legal reform.
